snippets.title: Automated E2E Payment Test Snippet

mazherReview.critique: Unreliable test. Hardcoded 5-second sleep causes flaky runs; raw card numbers violate synthetic data guidelines; missing error assertions; no accessibility locator strategy; no retry logic for transient network hops.
improvements: Replaced brittle CSS selectors with accessible roles (getByRole)
Eliminated arbitrary sleep (waitForTimeout) in favor of network event awaiting
Added explicit verification of backend reconciliation response
Validated aria-live status container for screen-reader accessibility
